page.overview:
Who is Badrukk?

Badrukk, better known as Kaptin Badrukk, but also called the "Hero of the War of Dakka," the "Breaker of the Grand Guard" and the "Plunderer of Tanhotep," is one of the most infamous Ork Freebooterz or space pirates of all time.

Badrukk has plied the stars in his steel-jawed Kill Kroozer Da Blacktoof for several blood-splattered solar decades. He is the commanding officer of the Ork pirate band known as "Badrukk's Flash Gitz" who have fought with many of the Ork warbosses active in Imperial space, including most of the more recent warlords and their WAAAGH!s.

He holds forth to any who will listen that without the devastating weapons of his Gitz, many of those selfsame warlords would have been long dead -- a claim that any who have seen this pirate band in action may well believe.

Kaptin Badrukk is the greatest Ork Freebooter of his age, a monstrous, roaring Greenskin privateer bedecked in barbarous finery. Badrukk's Flash Gitz carry enough firepower into battle to level a well-defended hab-block, and the kaptin totes the most fearsome firearm of the lot.
